capabilities: Add line numbers to code blocks
Show a file name in a bar above the code
Highlight specified lines with a colored background
Set a custom starting line number
Configure blocks per-block with first-line options
extras: Notes compatibility limits: code blocks inside lists are numbered in Reading view only, and it should not be combined with plugins that fully redraw code blocks.
problem: Obsidian code blocks have no built-in way to show line numbers, a file name, or highlighted lines.

relations.evidence: plugins like Execute Code keep working
Code Emitter, Execute Code and similar plugins: they still see the language as the first word
Code Styler and other plugins that redraw code blocks completely: they do the same job in their own way

summary: Code block decorator that adds line numbers, a file-name title bar and highlighted lines to fenced code blocks via first-line options.
